name: Variety Show – Volunteers & Important Info
description: We're gearing up for our upcoming Variety Show and need parent volunteers to help make it a success! Volunteer opportunities include Stage Hands, Concession Organizer, and we are looking for a volunteer who can provide a digital keyboard for the event. To Apply to the Variety Show: Do you have a talent to share? Sing, Rap, Dance, Lip Sync, Magic, Musical Instrument, Cheer Performance, Skit, Monologue, Jump Rope, Yo Yo, Puppet show, Comedy Routine, Impressions, Mime, Martial Arts demo, Poetry, Baton twirling.

name: Incoming 2025/26 Castillero 6th grade parents!
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants. If you are interested in getting involved, please contact Stephanie Pearson-Phillips (spearsonphillips@gmail.com or (650) 454-4389).

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed!
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding!

name: Yearbook Update
description: We are looking for photos from PTA events this year! If you have photos, please upload to the Google Drive Folders. 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages! They are due by March 31st!
